about: The Hold's run (docs/design/the-hold.md, World.Hold.cs). health is the keep's. A wave is first plus growth a wave, each raider hpPerWave stronger; adjectives come in from adjectiveFrom, percent of a wave's raiders adjectivePercent. strength is how many blows of a raider a blocking terrain takes (none: it can't be battered); a way through it costs batterCost a blow. An adjective's hp is a percent of its raider's; keeps is a status it never loses, lights that it fires the ground it steps on, color how it looks.
